a = 17*2
b = 35

if a+b == 69 do
	 puts "Nice."

	 c = a + b

	 print "Value of c: "
	 puts c

	 if c + 1 == 70 do
	 		puts "ok!"
	 else
			puts "fuck me ;("
	 end
else
	puts "Wtf?"
end

if a == 34 do
	 print "a = "
	 puts a

	 if b == 35 do
	 	 print "b = "
		 puts b

		 if a + b == 69 do
		 		puts "Nice!"
		 else
				puts "Not nice ;("
		 end
	 else
			puts "b is not 35??"
	 end
else
	puts "a is not 34???"
end


puts "Do inner values leak?"

# did_i_leak = "I did NOT leak!"

if a+1 == b do
	 did_i_leak = "I leaked ;("
end

# Values created within conditions DO leak
# to their parent scope. This will be resolved later.
print "Did it leak?: "
puts did_i_leak
